result: acted: opened PR #787 for cascade join 2 — a change record is OPENED, not only read. The fabric could READ the change plane (lib/integrations/.../change-window) and could PLAN a resolution (signalgrid-core/resolution.ts), and nothing joined them: a plan that required a change to a managed system had no way to say so in the system that governs changes. lib/integrations/src/integrations/itsm/change-draft.ts now turns a resolution plan into a change-request draft — what would change, on which target, why, which reason codes it would clear — submitted through resolveItsmEmitter, the same gate the ticket path passes. THE BACKLOG ROW'S OWN ASSUMPTION WAS WRONG AND THE PR SAYS SO: it placed this in change-window/, but that family's header forbids it a write path in any form — "SignalGrid raises no change, approves none, schedules none, closes none, and never writes a word back." Reading the change plane and opening a change record are different acts, so the draft went to the outbound family and the read-only family stays read-only; change-window types are imported for evidence only. THE THREE RULES ARE STRUCTURAL, NOT ASSERTED: status/approvalRequired/simulatedOnly are literal TYPES, so the type cannot express a pre-approved or self-executing draft, and submitting is not approving; all eight change-window postures including change_authorized draft byte-identically to no record at all, evidence field aside; and changeClass cannot reach draftChangeRequest at all — withChangeClass is a separate step — so the one field this family refuses to grade never reaches a branch that could grade it. FALSIFIED, NOT JUST ASSERTED: planting the relax defect (an approved window dropping the requires_approval steps) turns three independent checks red, summary=fail (39/42); restored, summary=pass (42/42) with a 3/3 self-test. The transport is a PARAMETER — it was almost a module-level lookup, which would have left the submitted and not_submitted arms unreachable by any test in this tree, and that is the same defect #782 was caught on. Gates quoted: preflight PASSED, 320 gates; Breadth lane PASSED, 57 proofs (56 before this branch); typecheck clean; review:invariants passed; derived-doc-figures 34 across 19 documents; guard-registry and figure guard both passed. Figures moved at the sentence, never at the deriver: proof gates 144 to 145 in five sentences, proof sources 143 to 144, surface coverage 2876 to 2878. ONE CHECK IS RED AND IT IS NOT THE DIFF'S: github-advanced-security died at session creation with CAPIError 400 "The requested model is not supported" before reading a line — GitHub's own model API refusing GitHub's own scanner. Not claimed as an outage, because the same check PASSED on #786 at 10:40:38Z and failed here at 11:25:36Z; the allowed re-run was attempted and refused 403 (a GitHub-managed dynamic run), so a standing-down comment was posted rather than a silent pass.
